verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Teller verifies ACH account details and ownership, and offers Zelle-only payments. It never documents processor partner integrations or a token-exchange mechanism that hands verified account credentials to third-party processors or platforms. Raw ACH details a developer could forward manually are a building block, not the capability itself. Sidecar is a Plaid-compatibility switch, not a processor handoff, so neither earns credit.
